name: s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::*/prefix* (all buckets, shared prefix) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn regression: arn:aws:s3:::*/prefix* wildcards the BUCKET (head '*'), so a matching key prefix in ANY bucket is readable - account-wide, not a single-bucket scope. The trailing 'prefix*' constrains only the key inside each of all buckets, not the bucket set. Previously CLEAN (DATA-EXFIL fail-open, T8). DATA-EXFIL must fire; CLI must exit non-zero.
